title: anthemis abrotanifolia
intro: Anthemis abrotanifolia, commonly known as the annual yarrow, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis abrotanifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
